name: Francisco Chahuán v ENAP and others (Quintero-Puchuncaví)
description: Recurso de protección brought by Senator Francisco Chahuán Chahuán and others against the Empresa Nacional del Petróleo (ENAP S.A.) and other operators of the Concepción Bay industrial hub (Quintero-Puchuncaví-Concón), concerning the acute air pollution episodes that in 2018 caused the poisoning of hundreds of residents. The judgment is part of a series of rulings of the Supreme Court (Rol 5888-2019; Rol 149171-2020; Rol 170273-2022; Rol 13923-2024).
outcome: Petition granted. The Supreme Court of Chile held that the State had violated the constitutional right to live in an environment “free from pollution”, imposing 15 concrete remediation measures: real-time monitoring, a prevention and decontamination plan, a diagnosis of environmental pathologies, emergency protocols.
